title: User Registration: Let Visitors Create Accounts | Orchard Core
description:
By default, only administrators create accounts on an Orchard Core site, and the login page has no way for a visitor to sign up.

The Users Registration feature adds a Register page and a link to it on the login page. Two settings decide how each account is checked before it can be used, email verification and administrator approval, and a third sets the theme of the Register page. This video enables the feature and follows a visitor through each case.

In this video:
• What the Users Registration feature adds
• Enable the feature and its Email dependency
• The three registration settings
• A visitor registers
• Verify email addresses with a confirmation link
• Approve accounts before they work
• Registration with Google, GitHub and Meta
